scope.summary: Implement the `text` command family over StudioTextStory/StudioTypeStyle: characters, ranges, per-range font/size/fill/decoration/OpenType, threaded stories, style binding. Consumes foundation TextEngine (MT-018); deduped from TextFrame/TextRange/Story/TextNode source DOMs into ONE family. Every text edit emits a StudioHistoryEntry (type edits are not a separate undo silo). Dry-run/receipt/undo/promotion; emits STUDIO_TEXT_EDITED.
acceptance_criteria: text family on one contract over TextEngine; unified undo; deduped; dry-run/promotion
proof_targets: text family runtime test on unified history
expected_tests: live: text.set_range_style dry-run + promote + undo (unified history)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No text automation, or a text-specific undo silo re-introduced.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
